verdict.rationale: Appwrite Storage documents a preview endpoint that resizes, crops, converts format, sets quality, adds borders and rotates images from a single upload. It also offers smart crop focus (gravity=auto via face and saliency detection) and serves assets through Appwrite CDN, so no self-run image pipeline is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the preview endpoint, and in-depth reference docs (parameters, limits, caching behavior) beyond marketing-page claims.
